title: Update lifecycle journal docs for native prewrite sizes and panic context
outcome: The lifecycle journal documentation accurately describes nativePreWrite observations and the bounded panic context/backtrace fields introduced by the main HTTP write adapter.
acceptance: docs/features/host-lifecycle-journal.md describes nativePreWrite as an active final encoded-body observation, including once-per-response 1 GiB reporting, exact known-size completeness before delivery and lower-bound unknown-length crossing; existing observation-only semantics remain clear.

The panic-record description includes capped route/session context or unknown and up to 32 raw Windows stack addresses with explicit unavailable capture elsewhere; no test reads repository Markdown or pins its phrases.
